chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ibn Sinan said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the thrice-divorced woman during her waiting period: does she have residence or maintenance? He said: Yes. The meaning in this report is one of two things: either it is to be understood as recommended (not obligatory), or the intended meaning is when she is pregnant, which indicates that.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on maintenance and residence for a thrice-divorced woman during her waiting period?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms that a thrice-divorced woman during her 'iddah retains rights to residence or maintenance, a ruling that presents a juristic nuance in Shia fiqh. Scholars reconcile this with the general principle of limited post-divorce support by interpreting the hadith as either indicating recommendation (istihbab) rather than strict obligation (wajib), or as a specific exception for pregnant women who remain in the marital home until delivery.
